items.title: Volkswagen (XTRA:VOW3) Puts New Vehicle Software And AV Data Partnerships To Work
items.summary: Volkswagen (XTRA:VOW3) agreed a vehicle electronics partnership with NXP Semiconductors to develop zonal architecture for future models. The group set up an autonomous driving data flywheel involving Porsche, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Voxel51 to refine software features. Management plans to use the shared data infrastructure across multiple brands to support software defined vehicle platforms over time. items.title: NXPI Q3 deep dive: structural growth in automotive, industrial, and data center segments
items.summary: Chip manufacturer NXP Semiconductors (NASDAQ: NXPI) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 19.3% year on year to $3.79 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $3.85 billion was less impressive, coming in 0.6% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.20 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
